mutations.name: codes sorted inside a family
mutations.old: fam = sorted(c for c in codes if family_of(c) == i)
mutations.new: fam = sorted((c for c in codes if family_of(c) == i), reverse=True)

mutations.name: families
missing rule is a problem
mutations.old: problems = [f"{c}: no rule text (write it in the table)" for c in sorted(codes) if not rules.get(c) or rules[c] == MISSING_RULE]

mutations.name: stale row is a problem
mutations.old: problems += [f"{c}: row for a code the validator never reports" for c in sorted(set(rules) - codes)]
